newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices firm on rising world market.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices firm on rising world market.

text.p: Indian copper prices gained further on Friday while other base metals remained steady in a narrow trade, dealers said.
Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,800 rupees on thin supplies and fresh speculative buying on the back of rising global prices, they said.
Sentiment firmed with traders expecting state firm Hindustan Copper Ltd to raise its December selling prices in view of a buoyant market. Copper rose by 200 rupees on Thursday.
Aluminium was steady at 7,300 rupees, zinc at 6,450 and lead at 4,600. Tin was steady at 34,900 rupees and nickel at 37,100.
